title: SESC Pompeia
description: A cultural and recreational complex that transforms an old industrial factory into a vibrant public space. Its exposed concrete towers, bridges and open circulation create a strong relationship between architecture and everyday life.

title: Trellick Tower
description: A residential tower defined by its sculptural concrete structure and expressive service tower. Its strong vertical presence became one of the most recognizable examples of British brutalist housing.

title: National Assembly
description: A monumental architectural complex where geometric forms, massive concrete walls and carefully composed openings create a powerful relationship between light, space and civic identity.

title: Barbican Estate
description: An extensive residential and cultural complex combining elevated walkways, towers, gardens and textured concrete surfaces. Its urban scale creates an interconnected architectural landscape.
